name: Fresh Calendars News Desk
bio: The Fresh Calendars News Desk covers date changes that affect everyday planning in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada: federal and statutory holidays, daylight saving time rules, school calendar decisions and fixed retail dates. Every story is checked against a primary source such as a government notice, a school district announcement or an official agency calendar, and it links to the printable calendar or holiday page it updates. Corrections are noted at the end of the article with the date they were made.
